shots.content: Inside a game room, a rectangular board-game table stands between a shelving unit and the doorway, with a window along one side. A woman in an emerald sweater sits at the shelf-side window seat and tells a story about an error during a previous match, while a man in a navy hoodie sits at the doorway-side window seat, a woman in a burgundy blouse sits at the shelf-side aisle seat, and a man in a mustard polo sits at the doorway-side aisle seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from the doorway end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the shelving unit, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

shots.content: The man in the navy hoodie asks the woman in the emerald sweater how the situation was resolved.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in the emerald sweater answers and explains the final outcome of the game to the man in the navy hoodie and the woman in the burgundy blouse.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot from the shelving-unit end, looking lengthwise along the game table toward the doorway, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
